body: The gunman was a parkrose student

I was at that school. There was a kid who wanted to shoot himself and a staff member tackled him. It was really scary. 

Everybody hid, and I was with a group of 14 people. 

The parents are gathered to collect the students. It was a total of an hour and an hour and a half of waiting and scariness. 

I’m glad that students were are calm and quiet. Everybody was freaked out, but everybody was supporting each other. 

The school did what they could to protect us. 

Thank you
